title: The turn after a stopped one is told, once and across a host restart, which writes landed and which are unknown
steps: S1: an EmDash write lands after Stop; the host restarts; the next turn starts.
S2: an Apply write whose answer was lost after Stop.
S3: a turn not stopped; a write Stop kept from sending.
expect: S1: the next turn gets one notice naming it as landed; a later turn gets none.
S2: named as unknown, never landed.

selectors.code: host/stopped-writes.mjs, tracy-web sites/stopped-writes.js (migration 148), doors turn/stopped and turn/stopped/take

evidence: Review 19/10/2026: after Stop the log said 'tool call aborted' though the write could have landed; the next turn believed nothing changed
fence: A durable ledger of a stopped turn's writes, told once

tests: 🔒 Q2: an EmDash write lands after Stop, the host restarts, and the next turn is told it landed — once
🔒 Q2: an Apply write whose answer was lost after Stop is named as unknown, never as landed
🔒 Q2: a turn that was not stopped reports nothing and adds no notice; a write Stop kept from being sent is not named
